name: SC-MaxViT3D
hypothesis: Geometry-structured cross-view retrieval with symmetric side-feature comparison can improve the precision-recall tradeoff relative to matched unconstrained retrieval. Unverified.
augmentation_geometry: Shapes and strides specified before augmentation. Rotate/flip fine and downsampled cubic context together; pass per-sample transformed affine. Odd rotations of axes 1/2 swap spacing (2,2,1) to (2,1,2).
context_normalization: Use the fine input's supported mean/std; exclude invalid padding; masked normalized low-pass before decimation
split_access: Strictly within current split for labels AND amplitudes

preserved_baseline.decoder: Preserve dec4, dec3, dec2, dec1, dec0 and enc_full

context_encoder.blocks: depthwise separable 3-D residual convolution + GroupNorm + GELU

fusion.direction_source: learned feature vectors, orthonormalized with numerical safeguards; no ground truth used as input
fusion.invalid_sides: Do not synthesize contrast against zeros; disable side descriptors and provide validity state
fusion.residual_initialization: small nonzero; no trainable zero-initialized global gate

first_architecture_protocol.memory_fallback: Use context activation checkpointing first; if batch1/accum2 becomes necessary, rerun matched baselines at that microbatch
first_architecture_protocol.fairness_note: Batch normalization makes batch1/accum2 different from batch2 despite identical effective batch
first_architecture_protocol.initialization: random for all primary controls, shared initial state for shared layers where possible
first_architecture_protocol.optimizer_recipe: reuse current v3 AdamW and 10-epoch warmup plus cosine schedule without new changes
first_architecture_protocol.selection: max full validation micro IoU at threshold 0.5
first_architecture_protocol.test_use: only after architecture and threshold rules frozen; previously examined test is not a new blind holdout

primary_controls: MaxViT + identical context + unconstrained three-point groups, same reads and projections
required_followup_controls_if_promising: UNet with same context FOV and simple convolution fusion
standard CoTr-style free-point context aggregation at matched sampling budget
structured surface sampling with ordinary aggregation and no side contrast
without free points at fixed total reading budget
matched-capacity extra convolution and measured time/memory comparison

engineering_targets_not_forecasts.condition: AP must also improve over matched MaxViT; multi-seed and same-FOV controls must support independent mechanism value

implementation_gates: coordinate-ramp alignment and grid_sample axis tests
split-boundary sentinel test and exact evaluation-support counts
normal-sign invariance, all-invalid fallback and gradient checks
fixed-slice FP/FN plus offset and branch-contribution diagnostics
